source: UCI Combined Cycle Power Plant dataset
sample_order: Fixed held-out split order; the source records have no timestamps and are shuffled, not chronological.

fields.prediction_lower_MW: Lower bound of the split-conformal 90% benchmark interval (MW)
fields.prediction_upper_MW: Upper bound of the split-conformal 90% benchmark interval (MW)
fields.outside_reference_features: Inputs outside the model-fit 1st-99th percentile reference range
fields.t2_score: PCA Hotelling T-squared score in retained principal-component subspace
fields.q_residual_score: Squared PCA reconstruction residual outside retained subspace
fields.t2_reference_flag: Score exceeds the calibration-set 99th percentile reference threshold
fields.q_reference_flag: Score exceeds the calibration-set 99th percentile reference threshold
fields.t2_top_feature: Largest proportional input contribution to T-squared score
fields.t2_top_contribution: Largest proportional input contribution to T-squared score
fields.q_top_feature: Input with largest squared PCA reconstruction residual
fields.q_top_contribution: Largest squared PCA reconstruction residual contribution

prediction_interval.note: Empirical CCPP benchmark diagnostic; coverage is not guaranteed under distribution shift or on refinery data

process_monitoring.method: PCA multivariate statistical monitoring with Hotelling T-squared and Q residual statistics
process_monitoring.note: Unlabeled benchmark statistical outlier screen only; not a fault detector, and calibration may not hold under distribution shift
